defects.title: System page Gateway Start/Stop/Restart buttons can never succeed: the ported frontend POSTs with no confirm while the Qubit backend requires a confirmation
defects.repro: Open http://127.0.0.1:8890/system, click the Gateway card 'Restart' (or 'Stop'). Browser network: POST http://127.0.0.1:8890/agent/api/gateway/restart => [409] Conflict; request-body EMPTY. Console: '[ERROR] Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 409 (Conflict) @ .../gateway/restart'. Response: {"ok":false,"code":"GATEWAY_CONFIRM_REQUIRED","state":"CONFIRM_REQUIRED","action":"restart","detail":"gateway restart changes a service; re-issue with confirm=true ..."}. No restart occurs. The same mismatch makes the sidebar 'Restart Gateway' button (contexts/SystemActions.tsx) fail identically. Direct curl with {'confirm':true} works (real systemd transition, pid 1304912 -> 1491732) but no UI path sends confirm.
defects.root_cause: frontend/qubit-web/src/lib/api.ts:1634 restartGateway, :1981 startGateway, :1983 stopGateway all `fetchJSON('/api/gateway/<verb>', { method: 'POST' })` with no body; frontend/qubit-web/src/pages/SystemPage.tsx:335 runGateway calls them directly. Backend voicebridge/qubit_compat.py:2457 gateway_supervisor.control(confirmed=bool(b.get('confirm'))) -> voicebridge/gateway_supervisor.py:342 _authorize_control returns GATEWAY_CONFIRM_REQUIRED when confirmed is false and no confirmation_id (line 357-362).
defects.hermes_counterpart: /home/trick/.hermes/hermes-agent/web/src/pages/SystemPage.tsx:309 runGateway + /home/trick/.hermes/hermes-agent/web/src/lib/api.ts:1023 restartGateway (same no-confirm POST) BUT the reference backend /home/trick/.hermes/hermes-agent/hermes_cli/web_routers/actions.py:139 restart_gateway requires no confirmation, so the reference UI works. Qubit's port kept the reference call shape while adding a confirmation gate to the backend.
defects.proposed_fix: Update the three api.ts methods to send a confirm through the shared confirmation round-trip (like runMutationWithConfirm / MCP add) and have SystemPage.tsx runGateway handle the 409 by surfacing an inline Confirm/Cancel (the reference already gates shared-gateway restarts via ConfirmDialog in SystemPage.tsx:325 requestRestart/restartShared). Alternatively route through POST /api/ops/confirm for the staged confirmation_id the handler can mint. Rebuild frontend/qubit-dist.

defects.title: Gateway action status is permanently 'unknown': the UI polls /api/actions/gateway-restart/status which can never report the real restart
defects.repro: After a confirmed POST /agent/api/gateway/restart (which really restarts the service), GET /agent/api/actions/gateway-restart/status?lines=5 always returns {"ok":true,"running":false,"exit_code":null,"state":"unknown","lines":[],"detail":"no outcome recorded in this process; a gateway restart replaces the dashboard process"}. Because running is always false, SystemActions.tsx:47 reports success only via exit_code===0 (null -> shows the '(exit ?)' failure toast) and the poll loop exits immediately without confirming the restart.
defects.root_cause: voicebridge/qubit_compat.py:6950 h_action_status: the _ACTION_STATUS in-memory registry is reset when the process is replaced, and the supervision names always take the `state:unknown, exit_code:null, running:false` branch (:6960-6970). restart_gateway never calls record_action_status (voicebridge/qubit_compat.py:2495 h_gateway_restart returns its own payload; :6918 lists gateway-restart as a supervision name).
defects.hermes_counterpart: /home/trick/.hermes/hermes-agent/hermes_cli/web_routers/actions.py get_action_status over web_server_gateway._ACTION_LOG_FILES — the reference records the spawned action and its exit code on disk so the poll can report a real result.
defects.proposed_fix: Persist the gateway restart outcome to the action log (or a durable status record) before dispatching the detached restart, keyed by name 'gateway-restart' with exit_code/state, so the first poll after the process returns reads the real result. At minimum have h_gateway_restart write a durable receipt the status endpoint can read across the restart.

defects.root_cause: voicebridge/qubit_compat.py:3522-3530 — h_chat_stream defines a nested generator `_refused()` that references the exception variable `exc`; Python deletes `exc` at the end of the except block, so iterating the generator raises NameError and the SSE writer emits nothing (headers already sent as 200). defects.title: Unknown config key ending in _key/_token/_secret/_password misreported as SECRET_WRITE_REFUSED

defects.title: No /devices surface; device status/capabilities/tokens unreachable from the SPA
